name: Bloody Bride Imadoki no Vampire
original_name: Bloody Bride いまどきのバンパイア
source:
You play as a young vampire who has reached (vampire) adulthood. He is sent to earth to suck the blood of a girl with a 'platium aura'. However the girl has to willingly allow him to suck her blood. The character is given three years to complete his mission.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imadoki_no_Vampire:_Bloody_Bride]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名刚刚成年（以吸血鬼的标准而言）的年轻吸血鬼。他被派往人间，任务是吸取一名拥有“白金灵气”的女孩的血。然而，必须由女孩自愿允许他吸血。主角有三年时间完成任务。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Imadoki_no_Vampire:_Bloody_Bride]Wikipedia[/url]]
